title: Web: weight detail
description: GET /api/coach/home/weight?day=YYYY-MM-DD&weeks=1|2|4|12|26|all (default today, 4 weeks; all: from the first weigh-in). Weight as it stood that day: the latest weigh-in, the 7-day trend, the weekly rate against the band, and the chart series ending the day.

trend_kg.description: Mean of the non-outlier weigh-ins in the 7 days ending the day; null with too few.

band.description: The active phase's band (kg per week) for the day's phase week; null before a phase or without a band.

series.description: weeks x 7 days ending the day (all: from the first weigh-in, at least 7 days), oldest first. kg: that day's weigh-in (outlier: left out of the trend). band_low_kg/band_high_kg: the band as a weight corridor, starting at the trend on the first day in the range inside the active phase and past the glycogen window, then rising by the band's low/high rate a week; null before it.

recent.description: Every weigh-in on or before the day, newest first; outliers marked (likely typos, left out of the trend).

waist.description: Waist values on or before the day, newest first (at most 12), including the active phase's start value on its start date.

prediction.description: The check-in week holding the day: the trend predicted for its end (last week's trend + the planned surplus x 7 / kcal per kg, as the weekly check-in predicts it) against the trend on the day. complete: the day is the week's last. null before a phase or without last week's trend.
